findings.claim: The position check compares the full compareDocumentPosition bitmask for exact equality to Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING instead of masking with & as other tests in the feature do, which makes the assertion more brittle than the repo's established pattern.

The test retrieves the banner and trusted table elements with queryByTestId and chains them with a nullable &&, so a missing element silently passes null through instead of the test failing with a clear error, unlike other tests in the feature that use getByTestId.

The test is named to verify the banner appears above both sections but only checks its position relative to the trusted table, leaving the ordering against the owned table (onboarding-owned-table) unverified.
